executive_sections.title: Executive decision
items: Why it fits: Meets every hard constraint with the smallest managed surface
Construction boundary: OUT-001 — Deliver the FR-001 outcome

decisions.owner_effect: This defines the application shape, runtime, framework, and one approved source location.
decisions.selection: Whole-system architecture: CAND-0001; Application Runtime: Python; Application Framework: FastAPI; Frontend Framework: NOT_APPLICABLE — server-rendered interface; Application source: GREENFIELD_APP_ROOT: app/**
decisions.why: Meets every hard constraint with the smallest managed surface It is current, supported, and fits the approved local slice It provides the smallest typed HTTP surface for the approved journey The approved slice uses a server-rendered interface A singular application root prevents competing app, apps, or src trees.
decisions.alternatives: CAND-0002 A second runtime would add packaging and operations cost A larger framework adds features the first release does not need A separate browser framework adds a second build surface apps/** and src/** were rejected because parallel roots make ownership, imports, tests, and packaging ambiguous.
decisions.tradeoff: No migration required No continuously provisioned compute to operate Pay per request with no intentional idle compute The selected framework must fit under app/; approved root toolchain files remain allowed.
decisions.risk_and_mitigation: Validate with the task command Managed-service limits Validate quotas and alarms before deployment New application code has one predictable home under app/, with tests and infrastructure in their own roots.
decisions.evidence_status: SOURCE_VERIFIED — AWS-EV-0001
decisions.reconsider_when: Application Runtime policy CURRENT_LTS_AS_OF: 2026-07-01 Application Framework policy COMPATIBLE_MAJOR: 1 Frontend Framework policy NOT_APPLICABLE — server-rendered interface Reassess on quota, residency, or latency changes Reassess at sustained utilization where containers are cheaper Reopen only if an approved product or framework constraint cannot be satisfied under app/**.
